result.summary: Independently re-derived git diff 401080e..357d1c2 -- messages/kk.json and found it changes 17 keys, not the 15/16 CONTENT-BA's report claims (12 originally-flagged + Footer.licenseContent + 3 newly-found = 16 named keys; report additionally says 'exactly 15 changed lines'). The undisclosed 17th changed key is Events.lede ('Екі митапта жеті Talk' -> 'Екі митапта жеті баяндама'), which was silently modified without appearing in either the flagged list or the '3 newly found' list. On its own the Events.lede edit is CORRECT (баяндама matches ru.json's 'докладов' at the same key, same Talk->баяндама pattern as the other fixes) -- this is a self-report accuracy defect, not a translation-quality regression. Per core-directives.md's re-derive requirement, a validator must catch exactly this kind of mismatch between what was reported and what the artefact actually shows, independent of whether the undisclosed change happens to be benign. All other checks pass: (1) each of the 16 keys CONTENT-BA did name -- Nav.events, Nav.chapters, Hero.ctaPrimary, Band.lede, Creed.principle2Body, Metrics.sourceNote, Doors.door1Body, Doors.door2Link, Events.eyebrow, MapSection.nodeAlmatySub, MapSection.ctaLaunchChapter, Streams.stream1Title, Partners.partner1Desc, Partners.disclaimer, Team.team5Role, Footer.licenseContent -- independently checked against ru.json's actual meaning at that key: all are genuine, natural Kazakh translations (e.g. Nav.events 'Іс-шаралар' matches ru 'События'; Doors.door2Link 'Баяндама ұсыну' matches ru 'Подать доклад'; Footer.licenseContent 'МАЗМҰН' matches ru 'КОНТЕНТ' as a native Kazakh word, not a loanword duplicate). (2) Independent full re-scan of all 177 keys via a script matching whole-word 'Event(s)/Chapter(s)/Talk(s)/Speaker(s)' in kk.json values found zero remaining instances -- CONTENT-BA's re-scan for this specific pattern was complete. A broader scan for any other Latin word present in a kk value but absent from the corresponding ru value found only Kazakh case-suffix constructions glued onto proper nouns/acronyms already verbatim in ru.json (e.g. 'Verigram-да', 'Bank-та', 'story-ден') -- expected and legitimate, not new substitutions. (3) Footer.licenseCode='КОД'/licenseBrand='БРЕНД' judgment call assessed and AGREED: kk.json itself uses 'бренд' natively 6+ times elsewhere in unrelated prose (Metadata.description, Hero.subtitle, Creed.lede, MapSection.lede, Team.lede, Footer.about) and 'код' natively in Streams.foundationBody ('ашық код'), in both cases matching ru.json's own identical Cyrillic usage -- these are genuine established Kazakh loanwords per the file's own internal evidence, not a translation gap CONTENT-BA quietly avoided. (4) No regression on other REQ-006 criteria: Metadata.ogLocale is exactly 'kk_KZ'; all 8 status-label keys (chapter{1-4}Status, stream{1-4}Status) are plain lowercase Kazakh; zero exclamation marks or emoji anywhere in the file; Kazakh-specific letters (Ә/Ғ/Қ/Ң/Ө/Ұ/Ү/Һ/І) appear in 116/177 keys (up from 111/177 pre-rework) spread across all 13 namespaces, not clustered. messages/kk.json remains valid JSON with 177 keys matching ru.json's key set exactly.
